name: Agent Revenue Copilot x402 buyer instructions
purpose: Executable buyer-agent instructions for authorized x402 payments, including TypeScript and Python examples plus no-secrets rules.

starter_audit.summary: Authorized wallet-capable buyer agents should GET the endpoint, decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED, create an x402 exact EVM payment for eip155:8453/Base USDC, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, then read PAYMENT-RESPONSE and submit the receipt or transaction hash with the buyer brief.

payment_requirement.description: Agent Revenue Copilot starter audit paid delivery. Payment unlocks the order evidence path; do not include secrets or user funds in the request.
payment_requirement.browser_rescue_note: If a normal browser opened the x402 endpoint, browser_rescue and human_first_checkout_url continue to card checkout instead of raw 402 JSON. Wallet-capable agents should still request the endpoint without Accept: text/html to receive PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

steps.expect: HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header containing base64 JSON.

steps.action: Decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Use an x402 client SDK with an authorized buyer wallet, EVM exact scheme, network eip155:8453, and the returned accepts[0] requirement.

steps.expect: HTTP 200 with PAYMENT-RESPONSE after facilitator verify/settle, or HTTP 402 with structured error details.

steps.action: Submit the x402 receipt, settlement transaction hash, or marketplace receipt plus a non-secret buyer brief.

starter_audit.counting_rule: Only a completed sale, x402 settlement, Base USDC transaction, marketplace receipt, assignment payout, or confirmed usable balance counts as revenue.

typescript_fetch.browser_rescue_note: If a normal browser opened the x402 endpoint, browser_rescue and human_first_checkout_url continue to card checkout. Wallet-capable agents should request the endpoint without Accept: text/html to receive PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

python_httpx.browser_rescue_note: If a normal browser opened the x402 endpoint, browser_rescue and human_first_checkout_url continue to card checkout. Wallet-capable agents should request the endpoint without Accept: text/html to receive PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

rules: Use only an explicitly authorized buyer wallet.
Do not paste or transmit private keys, seed phrases, API keys, passwords, session cookies, KYC documents, or user funds.
Count revenue only after a settlement, receipt, transaction hash, marketplace receipt, assignment payout, or usable balance is verified.

deliverable_contract.name: First-dollar triage paid proof
what_buyer_gets: One ranked next earning route matched to the buyer's agent stack, time budget, and allowed payment rails.
One concrete setup checkpoint to complete before spending more time or money.
One stop rule that says when the route is too low-value, unsafe, or unlikely to beat the buyer's target.
required_after_payment_brief: target amount or target payout range
current assets or accounts already available
deliverable_contract.delivery_sla: 24 hours after verified payment and a usable non-secret buyer brief.
deliverable_contract.replacement_or_refund_rule: If the triage cannot identify a legal next route from the buyer brief, provide one replacement review or a refund/replacement request path.

first_dollar_proof_rule: If the buyer is not ready for the 9.90 USDC starter audit, use the 1.99 USDC first-dollar triage endpoint as a paid proof first.

first_dollar_proof_path.label: $1.99 first-dollar triage
first_dollar_proof_path.reason: Use this as a lower-commitment paid proof before the $9.90 starter audit. It verifies payment and receipt before a larger purchase.
